answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the forge checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The falcon graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the thread audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 55 keys loses far more than 55 single identities would. That is 32 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
